name: ui/macos-notification
title: macOS notification banner
desc_vi: Banner thông báo kính mờ ở góc phải trên, trượt vào từ phải, giữ một lúc rồi trượt ra.
params_vi: app_name, time_label, title, body: chữ · icon_letter: chữ trong ô icon (mặc định HF) · icon_from, icon_to: màu gradient icon · right, top: vị trí (px) · exitAt: giây trượt ra (null = ở lại)
notes: Sizes, colours, radii and timings as in the source (slide in at 0.2 s for 0.5 s power3.out, out at 4.2 s for 0.3 s power3.in). Differences: font = the film's font (source: Inter from Google Fonts); all texts are params with Vietnamese defaults; the 5 s composition length is the demo duration; the exit is a param (exitAt, null = no exit). The banner uses backdrop-filter blur(40px), so ae is png (AE has no backdrop blur). 05/10/2026: source artwork restored as default (user's decision: open-source registry artwork is used as shipped): the app icon is the source's own SVG, a 36 px violet gradient square (#6366f1 -> #8b5cf6, rx 8) with the bold "HF" mark; params icon_letter (the mark text), icon_from and icon_to still let a film pass its own.
